notes.title: Update has just been released! Dark Overlord on OS X now!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

We've just updated the game adding support of OS X.
Also Korean and Ukrainian languages were added.

And the DEMO version will be available in a few days.
For those who hasn't bought it yet, it might be interesting for you to try the DEMO version!

Hope you enjoy it.
